content: To log in to WikiDoc and ensure you receive proper credit for your contributions, follow these steps: 1. Locate the login link in the upper right corner of the page. 2. Enter the required information, including your full name. It is recommended to use your full name so that you can be appropriately credited for your contributions. 3. Select the option to create a new account. 4. Once your account is created, you will receive an email confirming your registration with WikiDoc. It is important to ensure that you are logged in every time you make a contribution. This will allow your contributions to be properly credited to your name on the history page. If you fail to log in, your IP address will be displayed instead of your name, and you will not receive the credit you deserve for your work.
